answer: The standard working week at Northwind Labs consists of 38 hours, which are typically spread over five days [1].
Employees must be available during the core collaboration hours of 10:00 to 15:00 local time [4].
Overtime worked on a public holiday is compensated as time off in lieu at a rate of 1.5 hours per hour worked [1].
Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year [2].
Full-time employees can carry over up to five unused annual leave days into the next calendar year [3]. Any remaining balance above five days expires on 31 March of the following year [3].
Employees must provide a medical certificate starting from the third consecutive day of sickness [1].
Employees may work remotely for up to three days per week after successfully completing their probation period [1].

Yes, working from another country is permitted for a maximum of 20 working days per calendar year [1]. This arrangement must be registered with HR at least two weeks before your departure due to tax and insurance rules [1].

Yes, after completing probation, employees receive a one-off home office allowance of 300 euros, which is paid with their first salary [1]. Additionally, employees may order an ergonomic chair, an external monitor, and a keyboard and mouse set from the approved catalogue [1].
Meal expenses are capped at 60 euros per day while travelling, but alcohol is never reimbursed [1]. Therefore, the company will not pay for wine with dinner [1].
The maximum hotel price per night in London is 250 euros [1].
Each employee receives an annual learning budget of 1,500 euros that can be spent on courses, certifications, conference tickets, and technical books [1].
Salary adjustments are decided once a year after the March review and take effect from 1 April [4].
When resigning after probation, the notice period is three months, unless your employment contract states otherwise [1].

Remaining annual leave should be taken during the notice period when leaving the company [2]. If taking the remaining leave is not possible, any unused days are paid out along with the final salary [2].
Business travel expenses must be submitted with their receipts through the finance portal within 30 days of the trip [1]. Receipts are mandatory for any single expense above 25 euros [1].
Company passwords must contain at least 14 characters [1].
No, SMS codes are not accepted as a second factor for authentication [1].
Administrators are required to use hardware security keys as a second factor [1].
No, company account passwords are not rotated on a fixed schedule [1]. However, they must be changed immediately if a compromise is suspected [1].
Customers' personal data, which is classified as Restricted data, may only be stored in the approved data platform in the EU region [1].
Operating system security updates marked as critical by IT must be installed within 72 hours of their release [5].
Your screen must lock automatically after five minutes of inactivity [1].
USB storage devices are blocked by default [1]. However, they can be enabled for a maximum of seven days upon request [1].
Managers review the access rights of their team every quarter [1].
Accounts of people leaving the company are disabled on their last working day by 18:00 [5].
Severity 1 security incidents are classified as the most severe level [1]. This category covers confirmed breaches of Restricted data as well as ransomware [1].
Production databases are backed up every six hours [1], [3].
The recovery time objective for critical systems is eight hours [1].
External vendor access to internal systems is granted for a maximum of 30 days and is renewable [1].
Employees who click a simulated phishing link are assigned a short follow-up module instead of facing disciplinary action [2].

The CloudBox S2 enclosure is covered by a limited hardware warranty of three years from the purchase date [1]. Supplied drives are covered for two years, and the power adapter is covered for one year [1].
Yes, the drives supplied with the CloudBox S2 are covered under the hardware warranty for two years [1].
Data stored on the device is never covered by the warranty [1]. Northwind Devices is not responsible for lost data and does not perform data recovery [1].
The limited hardware warranty for the CloudBox S2 does not cover damage caused by liquid [2]. Therefore, spilling coffee on the device is not covered [2].

Products purchased directly from the Northwind Devices online store can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided the device is undamaged and all accessories are included [1].
The customer pays return shipping unless the device is faulty [1].
Refunds for products bought directly from the Northwind Devices online store are issued to the original payment method within 14 days after the returned device has been inspected [1].

To start a warranty claim, open a return merchandise authorisation request in the support portal [1]. Support will conduct a remote diagnosis with the customer, and if the fault is confirmed, a prepaid shipping label is emailed within two working days [1]. To claim warranty service, customers must also provide the device serial number along with a proof of purchase that shows the date and the seller [5].

For the first year of the warranty, an advance replacement service is available where the replacement is shipped first, and the customer returns the faulty unit within 14 days in the same packaging [1]. Otherwise, a fee of 120 euros is charged [1].
If the faulty unit is not returned within 14 days in the same packaging when using the advance replacement service, a fee of 120 euros is charged [1].
Security updates for the CloudBox S2 firmware are provided for at least five years after the product was last sold [3].
Firmware updates install automatically between 02:00 and 05:00 local time [1]. However, this automatic installation will not occur if automatic updates are disabled in the settings [1].
Installing unofficial firmware does not, by itself, void the hardware warranty [1], [2]. However, it does void software support [1], [2].
The CloudBox Care plan costs 39 euros per year [1].
No, Northwind Devices cannot read files stored on the device when using remote access through the CloudBox relay service, as it is end-to-end encrypted [5].
Northwind Cloud commits to a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.95 percent for Enterprise subscriptions [1].
Downtime is defined as a period lasting for at least five consecutive minutes [1].
Business subscriptions earn a 25 percent credit if monthly uptime drops below 99.0 percent [1].
Service credits must be requested by submitting a support ticket within 30 days following the end of the affected month [1]. These credits are subsequently applied to the next invoice [1].
Service credits are the sole remedy for missed availability and cannot be exchanged for cash [1].
For Business subscriptions, the first response target for a Priority 1 issue (where the production service is down or unusable for all users) is one hour [1].
Enterprise subscriptions receive a 15-minute first response time for Priority 1 support requests, which are available around the clock [1].
If a Priority 1 issue is not resolved within four hours, the customer may escalate to the duty engineering manager through the escalation number in the console [1].

Routine maintenance takes place on Sundays between 01:00 and 05:00 UTC [1]. Customers are notified at least seven days in advance through the status page and by email [1]. Emergency maintenance for critical security vulnerabilities may be performed with 24 hours' notice [1]. Total maintenance is limited to eight hours per calendar month [1]. Scheduled maintenance announced in advance is not counted as Downtime [4].

Customers are notified of routine maintenance at least seven days in advance through the status page and by email [1]. Emergency maintenance to fix critical security vulnerabilities may be performed with 24 hours' notice [1].
After a subscription ends, customer data remains available for export for 30 days [1]. Following this period, the data is permanently deleted within a further 30 days [1].
No, the commitments and uptime guarantees in the agreement do not apply to features that are labelled as preview or beta [1].
Root cause analysis reports for Priority 1 incidents are published within five business days [2].
